Denel Land Systems is proud to announce its latest addition to its portfolio and the latest addition for the South African National Defense Force after a development time of nearly 5 years and building on past experiences and experiments under its ["Codename Rhino"](https://voat.co/v/ModernPowers/comments/856550)

The tank is named after the [Wildebeest](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wildebeest)

The tank has a four person crew as was experimented with in the [Tank Technology Demonstrator](http://www.globalsecurity.org/military/world/rsa/ttd.htm) in 1990.

The Wildebeest is the third indigenousness South African tank designed and built in South Africa and the second tank to enter service in the South African National Defense Force, the tank that did not enter service was the [TTD](http://www.army-guide.com/eng/product4421.html)

___

**Movement:**

The newly designed tank tracks were designed to reduce dust and sand clouds from moving across sandy terrains which are common in Africa where South Africa National Defense Force does most of its mission often on request of the African Union and Southern African Development Community

1850HP Unspecified Diesel Engine which exhaustgasses are cooled before exiting the vehicle to reduce the infrared signature.

___

**Defense:**

The Wildebeest uses [Advanced Modular Armor Protection](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Advanced_Modular_Armor_Protection) such as the AMAP-B heavy and AMAP-IED level 2, AMAP-S, AMAP-L and AMAP-SC

Being a modular system various other modules can be added depending on the mission and the requirements and the experience of the

Wildebeest features [AMAP-ADS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AMAP-ADS) which will be supplied by Rheinmetall. The SANDF requested an active protection system, South Africa saw the performance of the system during the testing on the Badger/Patria and requested the system for the Wildebeest.

___

**Armament**:

Wildebeest features a newly designed gun based on the [GT9 and the GT12](http://www.secretprojects.co.uk/forum/index.php?topic=9088.85;wap2) which are both 120mm guns called the GT13 features fully combustible catrigdes designed and built by Rheinmetall-Denel Munitions, the gun being designed in-house by Denel LIW.

The GT13 120mm / 53 caliber smooth-bore

M2 Browning 12.7mm Coaxially mounted to gun

M2 Browning 12.7mm for Anti-Air purposes

[Top-mounted](http://www.reutechsolutions.com/images/dynamic-control/missile-rogue.jpg) [Missile Rogue](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reutech_Rogue) which features 4 Ingwe anti tank missiles and a 12.7mm M2 Browning Machinegun built by the [South African Reutech](http://www.reutech.co.za/).

The Wildebeest has 54 Rounds for its Main Gun and 2000 Rounds for the 12.7mm M2 Brownings and an additional 4 Ingwe Missiles for the Missile

___

**Electronics:**

Arachnida III Weapons Management System developed for the Denel Wildebeest which is based on the Arachnida II which is the WMS for the Denel GV6-52.
